blocked_folds.label: in-sample blocks postdate the held block

clustered_dsr.clustering: target_date (the series is the per-date cluster mean)
clustered_dsr.headline: MAD-robust cross-trial SR variance (red team F2 S2: the plain variance is owned by near-constant-payoff phenotypes, E[max SR] ~1e14, DSR identically 0)
clustered_dsr.n_trials_definition: distinct phenotype hashes across the A, B, C ledgers

rule.name: planted_no_win3_bands3_sig4
rule.notes: FR-F2.4 planted-edge positive control rule: buy NO, taker, windows {>=24h,12-24h,6-12h}, bands {3-4F,4-5F,5F+}, sigma_cap 4.0 (3 active clauses).

planted.note: capture_ratio (the section 6.4 gate) is pick-level: (picks pooled on the planted frame - picks pooled on the original frame) / edge. With ~48 pick validation trades each flipped trade moves it by ~0.36, so it has one-trade granularity and a ~78% pass rate across re-plantings of the same picks (red team F2). rule_capture_ratio is the planted rule's own validation delta / edge (deterministic to rounding); pick_rule_overlap says how much of the picks' trade set lies inside the planted region.

rule.name: planted_no_win3_bands3_sig4
rule.notes: FR-F2.4 planted-edge positive control rule: buy NO, taker, windows {>=24h,12-24h,6-12h}, bands {3-4F,4-5F,5F+}, sigma_cap 4.0 (3 active clauses).

residual.note: raw pooled means are a diagnostic only: the residual shuffle keeps the market's late-day quotes, which already embed the observed high, so after re-settling on shifted truth every rule that fades a confident late quote wins (buy_no 3-6h longshot +0.64/contract under the null vs -0.05 real; fr31a +0.12 vs +0.07). The paired difference against the no-filter baseline under the SAME truth absorbs that inflation (FACTORY_ARCHITECTURE section 6.4a, 2026-09-03 amendment).
residual.statistic: paired: pooled(pick_k) - pooled(nofilter_no on the same shuffled-truth frame), per-date on the pick's validation dates

snapshot.p_rc_definition: feasible competition set (multiplicity.pick_multiplicity); *_all = every ledger phenotype

parity_pin.note: State of the forecast archive and CLI truth at the Phase-2 go/no-go (2026-07-26). F0's backfill (commit 9a8ed2e) appended four 2026-07-25 day-of gfs_mex vintages and post-07-25 truth rows, which moves the current-data fr31a taker result to 182 trades / +0.0649; the parity frame is built from these pinned blobs so the 181 / +0.0636 reference is reproduced exactly (FACTORY_ROADMAP F1 exit criterion 1).

A.competition_set: feasible: dates >= ceil(0.6 D) and trades >= 40, pick included; *_all: every distinct ledger phenotype

ALL69.competition_set: feasible: dates >= ceil(0.6 D) and trades >= 40, pick included; *_all: every distinct ledger phenotype

B.competition_set: feasible: dates >= ceil(0.6 D) and trades >= 40, pick included; *_all: every distinct ledger phenotype

C.competition_set: feasible: dates >= ceil(0.6 D) and trades >= 40, pick included; *_all: every distinct ledger phenotype

paired_vs_nofilter.rule: per-date (pick_k - baseline_k) on the dates the pick traded; baseline 0 where it did not trade

A.describe: direction_code == 1 & mode_code == 0 & window_code in bits(0b1001) & band_code in bits(0b10011) & p_win >= 0.75 & p_win <= 0.95 & quote >= 0.5 & sigma_f <= 3.5

ALL69.describe: direction_code == 0 & mode_code == 0 & window_code in bits(0b1) & band_code in bits(0b110010) & lead_bucket_code in bits(0b1) & quote >= 0.1 & quote <= 0.95 & sigma_f <= 4.0

B.describe: direction_code == 1 & mode_code == 0 & window_code in bits(0b111) & band_code in bits(0b11111) & p_win >= 0.85 & p_win <= 0.95 & quote >= 0.45 & quote <= 0.8 & sigma_f <= 3.0

C.describe: direction_code == 1 & mode_code == 0 & window_code in bits(0b11011) & band_code in bits(0b101111) & p_win >= 0.95 & yes_ask < 1.0 & p_yes <= yes_ask - 0.08 & quote <= 0.95 & sigma_f <= 4.0 & edge_distance_f >= 3.0

adverse_0.02.price_rule: price_paid = quote + 0.02; fee held at the frame's value

adverse_0.03.price_rule: price_paid = quote + 0.03; fee held at the frame's value

embargo_2.note: the same picks scored on the validation dates of a frame REBUILT with calibration embargo_days = 2 (section 5.8 sensitivity); the run's frame uses embargo_days = 1

tail_ratio.note: informational: R3 #4 tail ratio on the last-vintage Gaussian; not part of the verdict

verdict.rule: PROPOSED iff every headline campaign (A/B/C/ALL69) has a pick, pooled boot_lo > 0, Holm p < alpha, p_RC(ALL69) < threshold on the feasible competition set, beats every snapshot replicate's pooled validation and the residual null's paired-delta p95 (section 6.4a), and every section 5.8 gate; embargo-2 is not applicable unless a rebuilt embargo-2 frame was supplied; otherwise CLOSED (section 6.3)
